accelevents_identities_entity_owner.name: accelevents_identities_entity_owner
accelevents_identities_entity_owner.value:
(
        "accelevents_external_identities"."entity_type" = 'speaker'
        and "accelevents_external_identities"."speaker_id" = "accelevents_external_identities"."entity_id"
        and "accelevents_external_identities"."talk_id" is null
      ) or (
        "accelevents_external_identities"."entity_type" = 'talk'
        and "accelevents_external_identities"."speaker_id" is null
        and "accelevents_external_identities"."talk_id" = "accelevents_external_identities"."entity_id"
      )

accelevents_items_result_shape.name: accelevents_items_result_shape
accelevents_items_result_shape.value:
("accelevents_import_items"."action" = 'failed'
        and "accelevents_import_items"."local_id" is null
        and "accelevents_import_items"."error_code" is not null
        and "accelevents_import_items"."error_detail" is not null)
        or ("accelevents_import_items"."action" <> 'failed'
        and "accelevents_import_items"."local_id" is not null
        and "accelevents_import_items"."error_code" is null
        and "accelevents_import_items"."error_detail" is null)

api_keys_hash_format.name: api_keys_hash_format
api_keys_hash_format.value: length("api_keys"."key_hash") = 64 and "api_keys"."key_hash" = lower("api_keys"."key_hash") and "api_keys"."key_hash" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'

assets_current_lineage_unique.name: assets_current_lineage_unique
assets_current_lineage_unique.where: "assets"."current" = 1 and "assets"."speaker_id" is not null and "assets"."purpose" is not null

auth_tokens_hash_format.name: auth_tokens_hash_format
auth_tokens_hash_format.value: length("auth_tokens"."token_hash") = 64 and "auth_tokens"."token_hash" = lower("auth_tokens"."token_hash") and "auth_tokens"."token_hash" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'

events_date_order.name: events_date_order
events_date_order.value: "events"."starts_at" is null or "events"."ends_at" is null or "events"."ends_at" >= "events"."starts_at"

forms_date_order.name: forms_date_order
forms_date_order.value: "forms"."opens_at" is null or "forms"."closes_at" is null or "forms"."closes_at" >= "forms"."opens_at"

idempotency_completion_state.name: idempotency_completion_state
idempotency_completion_state.value: ("idempotency_records"."status" = 'in_progress' and "idempotency_records"."completed_at" is null) or ("idempotency_records"."status" <> 'in_progress' and "idempotency_records"."completed_at" is not null)

mail_deliveries_sent_state.name: mail_deliveries_sent_state
mail_deliveries_sent_state.value: ("mail_deliveries"."status" = 'sent' and "mail_deliveries"."sent_at" is not null and "mail_deliveries"."provider_message_id" is not null) or "mail_deliveries"."status" <> 'sent'

mail_snapshots_template_event.name: mail_snapshots_template_event
mail_snapshots_template_event.value: "mail_delivery_snapshots"."template_id" is null or "mail_delivery_snapshots"."event_id" is not null

mail_snapshots_content_state.name: mail_snapshots_content_state
mail_snapshots_content_state.value: ("mail_delivery_snapshots"."redacted_at" is null and "mail_delivery_snapshots"."rendered_html" is not null) or ("mail_delivery_snapshots"."redacted_at" is not null and "mail_delivery_snapshots"."rendered_html" is null and "mail_delivery_snapshots"."rendered_text" is null and "mail_delivery_snapshots"."ics_filename" is null and "mail_delivery_snapshots"."ics_content" is null)

review_assignments_recusal_state.name: review_assignments_recusal_state
review_assignments_recusal_state.value: ("review_assignments"."status" = 'assigned' and "review_assignments"."recusal_reason" is null and "review_assignments"."recused_at" is null) or ("review_assignments"."status" = 'recused' and "review_assignments"."recused_at" is not null)

review_rounds_date_order.name: review_rounds_date_order
review_rounds_date_order.value: "review_rounds"."starts_at" is null or "review_rounds"."ends_at" is null or "review_rounds"."ends_at" > "review_rounds"."starts_at"

reviewer_invitations_acceptance_state.name: reviewer_invitations_acceptance_state
reviewer_invitations_acceptance_state.value: ("reviewer_invitations"."status" = 'accepted' and "reviewer_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "reviewer_invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" is not null) or ("reviewer_invitations"."status" <> 'accepted' and "reviewer_invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "reviewer_invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" is null)

reviews_actor_kind.name: reviews_actor_kind
reviews_actor_kind.value: ("reviews"."ai" = 1 and "reviews"."reviewer_user_id" is null) or ("reviews"."ai" = 0 and "reviews"."reviewer_user_id" is not null)

tasks_form_kind.name: tasks_form_kind
tasks_form_kind.value: ("tasks"."kind" = 'form' and "tasks"."form_id" is not null) or ("tasks"."kind" <> 'form' and "tasks"."form_id" is null)
